_comment: The LocalFold commit whose refold code this site carries. tools/sync-localfold.mjs copies the import closure of `entries` at exactly this commit into vendor/localfold-<commit>/ and writes web/localfold.js to re-export it. Nothing under vendor/ is edited by hand. `runtime` entries are copied the same way and re-exported by webgpu/localfold-runtime.js: the device request and WGSL rewrites (Firefox's compiler) this site's own engine uses.
